args.title: Update local setup steps for MinIO
args.body:
File: README.md

Add a line instructing users to set the `S3_ENDPOINT` when using MinIO, and include a note to create the bucket in the MinIO console. This resolves confusion and targets uploads locally as intended, instead of AWS.

file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The setup steps in the `README.md` are missing instructions to set the `S3_ENDPOINT` and create a bucket when using MinIO. These additions will align user expectations with actual configurations for local environments.
